### Summary

Implemented F003 by adding an optional `capability_id` field to `PMToolMappingConfig` (`scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/integrations/pm_tool_mapping.py`) and wiring a new `validate_adapter_capability_binding()` helper plus an `ADAPTER_KIND_CATEGORY` table into `adapter_registry.py`; the validator resolves the ID through the F001 `CapabilityIndex` and enforces that PM-tool adapters bind to a manifest with `category == "pm-tool"`. `default_resolver()` now lazily loads the manifest index and log-and-skips any adapter whose `capability_id` is unknown or category-incompatible, preserving the existing fail-loud-by-skip semantics so a typo in one record doesn't take down the whole resolver. Updated the canonical Linear fixture `docs/plans/2026-05-20-001-…/evidence/
